blind_read: The monkey appeared to join two vine plugs in front of its belly, then stared at the viewer beneath a jagged, slashed tail shape.

evidence.observation: The red and blue ends, each with its own curling vine, are separated by clear background. The lowered gaze is directed toward the gap.

evidence.pose: 0.62 s and 1.09 s / near contact and stare
evidence.observation: The red pins and white-blue end form one uninterrupted horizontal shape against the belly. While the monkey stares and the tail gains its red slash, this tiny assembly continues to read as coupled.

blockers: The held plugs read as connected. A visible gap through their full height would preserve the offline state when the tail signal appears.
